name: Purge v1.12.0
body:
## Release highlights

- **See what is in Everything else**: Click the row on the Overview and a map shows the space Purge doesn't list: app data, your own files, caches off its list, and what macOS manages. It is read only and moves nothing.
- **Leftovers find more removed apps**: Folders named after an app, and hidden home folders such as Antigravity's and Trae's, are now offered once the app is gone. Each row says what linked it to the app.
- **Uninstalling takes an app's hidden home folders**: Removing Trae or Antigravity lists their hidden folders in the review, Check First and unticked, instead of leaving them for Leftovers to find later.
- **Scheduled cleaning retries and asks**: A failed clean stays due and tries again in an hour. Turning the schedule back on starts a fresh interval. Purge asks before quitting during any clean.
- **One clean at a time**: Confirming a clean while another is running now says so, instead of running beside it or doing nothing.
- **App caches by their real shape**: Application Support caches are offered only inside a Chromium-shaped profile, shown as one row per app, with each folder named in the confirm sheet. GPU shader caches are included.
- **More caches on the list**: Codex, EffectCraft, the Dart analysis server and Antigravity's browser caches are Safe. The Hermes cache and Gradle wrapper downloads are Check First.
- **Large Files explains an empty result**: When nothing is listed, a card shows cloud-only files, media libraries it stepped over, the folders it checked and any macOS refused.
- **Apple Intelligence Download Again fixed**: It brings back only the sets Purge removed, in your Siri language, and Remove acts on the sets you confirmed.

## What's changed

* fix: keep a failed scheduled clean due, and say why Run now did nothing (#173) by @jithin-sabu in #214
* fix: refuse a confirmed clean while another clean runs, and say so (#173) by @jithin-sabu in #215
* fix: ask before quitting during an unattended clean (#173) by @jithin-sabu in #216
* fix: start a fresh interval when automatic cleaning is turned back on (#173) by @jithin-sabu in #217
* fix: a failed Run now never pushes the scheduled clean back, with the Run now alert screenshots (#173) by @jithin-sabu in #218
* ci: check the site's new safety page path, and allow a manual rebuild by @jithin-sabu in #219
* feat: show what is in Everything else (#220) by @jithin-sabu in #221
* feat: offer the caches the Everything else breakdown found off the list (#222) by @jithin-sabu in #223
* feat: find leftovers by owner ledger, Library cross-evidence and a dot-folder catalog (#224) by @jithin-sabu in #227
* feat: offer an app's catalog dot folders in the uninstaller (#228) by @jithin-sabu in #229
* fix: offer Application Support caches by their Chromium shape (#226, #130) by @jithin-sabu in #231
* fix: name each App Caches folder in the confirm sheets (#232) by @jithin-sabu in #233
* fix: download again only the Apple Intelligence sets Purge removed, in the Siri language (#179) by @jithin-sabu in #234
* feat: explain an empty Large Files result with a storage bar (#230) by @jithin-sabu in #235
* test: skip the Apple Intelligence store runs where the feature is gated off (#236) by @jithin-sabu in #237
* test: run the row icon tests on the main actor so they stop racing the icon cache (#236) by @jithin-sabu in #238

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/jithin-sabu/purge-app/compare/v1.11.1...v1.12.0
